newsitem.title: USA: Heico Corp says will buy Northwings.
newsitem.headline: Heico Corp says will buy Northwings.

text.p: Heico Corp said it has entered into an agreement to acquire Northwings Accessories Corp for a total consideration of $10.5 million, including $3.5 million in Heico stock and the balance payable in cash.
Heico said it expected the acquisition would immediately add to its net income and earnings per share. It anticipates completion of the purchase by September 30.
Northwings reported unaudited pre-tax income of about $2 million on revenues of about $5 million in the first six months of 1997, Heico said.
Northwings is an FAA authorised repair and overhaul facility servicing aircraft engine and airframe accessories.
Northwings' customers include many of the world's cargo and passenger airlines, Heico said.
The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, including approval by Heico's board, the company said.
